headline: Where and when Earth copies the low Sun of the Moon's south pole
purpose: Use this page to find where and when to rehearse rover operations, camera tests and crew work under the light of the Moon's south pole.
subline: A map and a calendar show the places and dates where the Sun stays that low over bare, snow-free ground. These places copy the height of the Sun and the length of the shadows. They do not copy the strong contrast of a world without air.
